children.value: > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried’s behavior after the fall of FTX suggests he’s something of a wild card.

> > Fact From Story: He may also introduce other evidence that could be troublesome — implying, for instance, that he was engaged in standard industry behavior or that everything that happened was Binance’s fault.
> > > Fact From Story: He must still think so, or he would not be dragging his closest companions’ names through the mud in a jury trial.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A person is unpredictable if they drag their closest companions' names through the mud in a jury trial.
> > Fact From Story: He may suggest he was acting on the advice of his lawyers.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A wild card is someone whose behavior is unpredictable.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A wild card may damage public perception of crypto at large.
